reviewer_prior_context: Authored exporter and build plans; nonblind route/source context. No new independent algorithm.
method: Read-only exact snapshot comparison, source diff review and hand derivation; no compiler or payload replay.

categories.reason: FD replacements call the same charged add helper; 2 initialization adds and 3 updates per x, including last x and both continue branches. Degree2 removes 5p Horner multiplies and changes adds by 2-2p. Native inverse expansion remains bitlength(p-2)+popcount(p-2), including the final square.
historical_exclusions: group/jacobian addition summaries are not extra field operations
report and host timing remain separate

categories.reason: Unchanged meter/scalar ledger and progress scalar dispatch; importer combines candidate native/query/setup scalar counters and removes expanded inverse multiplies once. Reference Ring stays atomic.
historical_exclusions: expanded inversion multiplications are removed once before atomic inverse price
primality powers are not inverse expansion

categories.reason: Actual outer p/r checks and unchanged constructor observers remain. Moved applicability parses method parameters/family predicates, invokes no field/geometry meter; it changes the wall boundary, not selected event counts.
historical_exclusions: prime call counts, product reductions, loop and witness counters are diagnostic and not added again

categories.reason: Progress snapshots preserve cold setup field/native counts before reset; final candidate arithmetic and field include setup once. Mapper separately includes setup symbolic counts, not duplicate field/native setup.
historical_exclusions: setup elapsed/allocation remain separate resources
candidate detail totals already add setup arithmetic and field counts before export

sparse_accumulations
partition_terms
payload_terms

internal mix/reduction and hash CPU expansion are not inferred

assumptions: Selected Some(sink) root route and concrete AtomicSink, not an arbitrary mutating custom Sink.
Canonical active coefficients, degree2 when sieve called, 0<p<=2^63 for safe u64 additions; intended finite prime cohort is within this domain. No universal large-u64 guarantee.
Thread-local meters are used serially and counters do not overflow.
Existing finite semantic model exclusions retained; no full machine instruction accounting.
remaining: Full root ecbench adapter compilation/integration obligation.
Fresh final optimized worker/mapper source closure and executable/protocol/image bindings.
Matched diagnostics/timing policy and actual retained session identity/custody.
Progress output is bounded diagnostic snapshots, not canonical relation-stream trace.

findings.text: Old complete coverage cannot be reused as new binary/protocol admission; this review deliberately does not emit mapper reviewed_complete status.
Applicability moves before solve timer; retained algorithm counters are unchanged, but prior wall intervals cannot silently be reused.
Progress serialization, snapshots, I/O and allocation overhead remain separate; completed_write_ns does not include all JSON construction and counter snapshot overhead.
FD safe-add precondition is documented in source rather than an explicit new public p<=2^63 guard. Review is limited to the intended bounded prime domain.

proves_too_much_checks: A null planned session cannot import an actual record: importer requires Some session.
Identical outputs alone do not preserve old counts: degree2 delta has -5p multiplies, 2-2p adds, 5-5p visits.
A source report with null executable/protocol cannot satisfy the existing complete binary review gate.
Canonical optional trace does not add trace capability to selected progress route.
